args.title: Corvid Packaging: Freight Pricing This Quarter (3-bullet summary)
args.body:
- Newsletter (Corvid Packaging, "Freight pricing this quarter"): This week's issue covers quarterly freight pricing; it links to the full article at blog.corvid.example/2026/freight.
- Article (blog.corvid.example/2026/freight): Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece (insights.corvid.example/freight/companion): Shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least.
